# Step 1: Retrieve the Earth-Moon distance using the research_agent
distance_text = research_agent(
    task="Find the average distance from Earth to the Moon in kilometers. Provide the number only, without additional commentary.",
    additional_args={}
)
print("Raw distance info:", distance_text)

# Step 2: Extract the numeric value (km) from the returned text
import re
match = re.search(r"([\d,\.]+)\s*km", distance_text.replace(",", ""))
if match:
    distance_km = float(match.group(1))
else:
    # Fallback to a known average value if parsing fails
    distance_km = 384400.0
print("Parsed distance (km):", distance_km)

# Step 3: Compute light travel time
c_km_per_s = 299_792.458  # speed of light in km/s
time_seconds = distance_km / c_km_per_s
time_hours = time_seconds / 3600
print("Light travel time (hours):", time_hours)

# Provide the final answer
final_answer(time_hours)
